name: Magma Core
summary: The Magma Core is the heart of Magma Lord Bokk, an elemental in the Burning Steppes. Mux Manascrambler needs its steady heat to power an extra-dimensional ghost revealer.

sections.title: A Heart of Heat
sections.body: Magma Lord Bokk dwells in the Burning Steppes, south of Blackrock Mountain. His Magma Core holds an endless supply of heat. Mux Manascrambler in Gadgetzan seeks it to keep ectoplasm active and power an extra-dimensional ghost revealer.

faq.answer: The Magma Core is the heart of Magma Lord Bokk, a mighty elemental in the Burning Steppes. It holds a powerful supply of heat.
Mux Manascrambler in Gadgetzan wants the Magma Core to power an extra-dimensional ghost revealer.
Magma Lord Bokk can be found in the Burning Steppes, south of Blackrock Mountain.
Mux needs a stable, portable source of energy to keep ectoplasm active and power his extra-dimensional ghost revealer.

angles.text: As an engineer, you may recognize why Mux wants a portable source of power: he means to use the Magma Core to run an extra-dimensional ghost revealer.
